# Adversarial review — Phase 26 SM1–SM10 structured integration (f680918)

Reviewed `spec/phase26/structured-merge.md`, `impl/src/structured-merge.mjs`, `impl/src/worktree.mjs` (structured staging/finalize/reconcile), `impl/src/coordinator.mjs` (`integrate`), `impl/src/index.mjs` (driver wiring), `impl/test/phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs`, `impl/test/phase11-acceptance-integration.test.mjs` (CK9 replay/authority), and `docs/handoff/evidence/phase26-structured-merge-2026-07-11.md`. Evidence prose and resolver/worker claims are not trusted; only source locations and executable failure sequences ground verdicts.

## Decision

**No actionable SM1–SM10 implementation defect remains at f680918.**

Every seam refuses or confines within the typed structured-merge TCB, main is not used as the merge workspace, fresh verification gates main movement, replay does not invent structured success, and CPG/behavioral fingerprints have no integration authority. Residual risk is explicit non-goal territory: live `mergiraf` binary behavior on operator hosts, true semantic merge, and false-clean merges when the pinned primary verification command is intentionally weak.

Adjacent gaps (invalid UTF-8 surfaced as generic `structured_merge_failed` rather than a dedicated code; custom non-`MergirafResolver` injectees without internal timeouts) are fail-closed or deployment-contract issues, not SM1–SM10 contract violations under the intended `createDriver({ structuredMerge: new MergirafResolver(...) })` production path.

## Proposed numbered contract

### SM1 — Injected external resolver

**Contract.** Production invokes `mergiraf solve <conflicted-path>` with fixed argv, no shell, bounded time/output, minimal environment. Missing, failed, timed-out, unknown, or parse-fallback outcomes refuse typed; textual fallback is never relabeled structured success. Resolver TCB is one bounded conflict file in an isolated directory, not the staging repository.

**Implementation verdict: SATISFIED.**

- `MergirafResolver` spawns with `shell: false`, `['solve', relativePath]`, `timeoutMs` SIGKILL, and rolling `maxOutputBytes` (`structured-merge.mjs:7-22`, `41-44`, `51`).
- Environment is stripped to `PATH`, `LANG: C`, `LC_ALL: C` (`structured-merge.mjs:43`).
- Outcomes classify as `parse_fallback` (regex on stdout/stderr), `unresolved` (non-zero exit), `unknown` (missing `solved N conflict` stdout), or `resolved` (`structured-merge.mjs:53-56`).
- Staging copies each conflict into `mkdtempSync(...'baton-structured-conflict-')`, passes only `basename(relativePath)` to the resolver, and never exposes the stage tree as resolver `cwd` (`worktree.mjs:311-315`).
- `createDriver` wires `structuredMerge` into `stageStructuredIntegration` (`index.mjs:90-91`, `215`).

**Non-goals.** No live `mergiraf` pass on this host (evidence §Validation). Resolver syntactic correctness beyond marker/diff-check/UTF-8 gates is external-tool semantics.

### SM2 — Main is never the staging workspace

**Contract.** Pin clean main HEAD, perform three-way merge only in a detached worktree under `.baton/integrate/`. Any pre-finalize failure leaves main HEAD, index, and worktree unchanged.

**Implementation verdict: SATISFIED.**

- Refuses dirty main before staging (`worktree.mjs:279`, `structured_main_dirty`).
- Creates detached stage at `join(repoRoot, '.baton/integrate', taskId-random)` from `beforeSha` (`worktree.mjs:287-289`).
- `coordinator.integrate` stages, verifies, then finalizes; merge/commit in stage use `core.hooksPath=/dev/null` (`worktree.mjs:294`, `338`).
- Failure path calls `removeStructuredIntegration` and coordinator removes verify sandboxes (`worktree.mjs:344-345`; `coordinator.mjs:1160-1162`, `1176-1177`).
- Red: `sm-dirty`, `sm-missing`, `sm-success` (integrate dir reaped).

### SM3 — Exact Git identities

**Contract.** Pin `beforeSha`, accepted `resultSha`, merge base, two-parent `stageSha`, conflicted paths. Invalid commits, already-integrated results, dirty main, or main advance between staging and finalize refuse without rewriting history.

**Implementation verdict: SATISFIED.**

- `resultSha` verified as commit; `merge-base --is-ancestor` rejects already-integrated results (`worktree.mjs:281-286`).
- Candidate commit parents checked: exactly `[beforeSha, rightSha]` (`worktree.mjs:340-342`).
- Finalize re-checks main clean, `HEAD === beforeSha`, and candidate parent identity before ff-only (`worktree.mjs:351-357`).
- Red: `sm-race` (main advance between verify and finalize → `structured_main_advanced`).

### SM4 — Fail-closed conflict classification

**Contract.** Clean Git three-way → `clean_textual`. Unresolved regular text may become `structured_resolved` via external resolver. Binary/deleted/unsupported paths, resolver fallback, non-success, remaining unmerged entries, diff3 markers, or `git diff --check` failure refuse. Classification is syntax/tool evidence, not semantic safety.

**Implementation verdict: SATISFIED.**

- Clean merge short-circuits without resolver (`worktree.mjs:298-299`).
- Per-path gates: realpath confinement, regular file only, NUL/binary rejection pre-resolver, `maxFileBytes` pre/post resolver (`worktree.mjs:304-310`, `318-319`).
- Post-resolver: UTF-8 `fatal` decode, `CONFLICT_MARKER` scan (7+ `<|=>` runs anywhere in decoded text), canonical path identity before write (`worktree.mjs:263`, `325-329`).
- Index hygiene: no remaining `U` entries; `git diff --check --cached` (`worktree.mjs:334-337`).
- Git subprocesses use `localGitEnv` (strip ambient `GIT_*`, disable system/global config) and diff3 merge style (`worktree.mjs:57-64`, `294`).
- Reds: `sm-markers`, `sm-marker-evasion`, `sm-marker-midline`, `sm-binary-input/output`, `sm-symlink-swap`, `sm-fallback`, `sm-file-bound`.

**Non-goals.** Semantically wrong but syntactically clean merges are SM6/SM10 boundary (verification strength), not SM4 classification failure.

### SM5 — Immutable candidate commit

**Contract.** Only fully resolved, `git diff --check`-clean stage becomes a two-parent merge commit with exact left/right parents. Candidate is not main and conveys no acceptance alone.

**Implementation verdict: SATISFIED.**

- Stage commit only after all paths resolved and diff-check passes (`worktree.mjs:334-339`).
- Parent equality enforced at creation (`worktree.mjs:340-342`) and again at finalize (`worktree.mjs:355-356`).
- Main does not move until SM6+SM7 (`coordinator.mjs:1138-1158` ordering).

### SM6 — Fresh post-merge verification

**Contract.** Before main moves, create a distinct verification worktree at `stageSha` and run the task's immutable pinned primary command. Failure is `structured_verification_failed`; stage reaped; main unchanged; no fabricated second red baseline.

**Implementation verdict: SATISFIED.**

- `createVerifyWorktree(..., structuredStage.stageSha)` then `_referee` with `task.brief.verification` (`coordinator.mjs:1139-1144`).
- Non-accept → `structured_verification_failed` before `finalizeStructuredIntegration` (`coordinator.mjs:1157-1158`).
- Verify sandbox uses `freshVerifySandbox` (separate `.baton/verify/` namespace, copied deps, optional sparse projection) — not the integration stage (`worktree.mjs:377-425`; `index.mjs:69-71`).
- Reds: `sm-success` (`integration.merge_reverified`, `verdict.reverified`), `sm-false-clean` (invalid JS merge → verification fail, main pinned).

### SM7 — One guarded main update

**Contract.** Only after SM6, require main still clean and at `beforeSha`, then fast-forward to `stageSha`. Record SHAs, per-path classes, resolver identity, fresh verdict. No push/deploy.

**Implementation verdict: SATISFIED.**

- Finalize path: `git merge --ff-only stageSha` with hooks disabled (`worktree.mjs:357-361`).
- Success record frozen in `integration` object with `strategy: 'structured'`, classes, resolutions, resolver, verdict (`coordinator.mjs:1158`, `1182-1207`).
- Red: `sm-final-hook` (post-merge hook does not run on main), `sm-clean-three-way` / `sm-success` (exact SHA recording).

### SM8 — Replay and authority

**Contract.** Operational success plus coordination integration batch is the only replayable success. Asymmetric decisions cannot reconstruct integration. Post-effect authority failure poisons; no silent hard-reset.

**Implementation verdict: SATISFIED.**

- Successful path calls `coordination.completeIntegration` with operational evidence and artifact (`coordinator.mjs:1189-1205`).
- Post-main coordination write failure: main may advance (two-parent HEAD) but `result(...).integration` is `null` on replay (`phase26` `sm-authority-failure`; mirrors Phase 11 `CK9: post-merge authority-batch failure poisons`).
- Asymmetric operational `integration.completed` without coordination pairing → replay `integration: null` (`phase11-acceptance-integration.test.mjs` `CK9: replay rejects an asymmetric integration decision`).
- Refusal retains `refs/baton/results/<sha>` (`coordinator.mjs:1119-1120`, `1169-1173`; `sm-missing`).

### SM9 — Cleanup and retention

**Contract.** Integration and verification worktrees reaped on success, refusal, timeout, and error. Successful main retains result and releases result pin. Refusal retains result ref. No stage branch.

**Implementation verdict: SATISFIED.**

- Stage is detached (`--detach`); no stage branch created (`worktree.mjs:289`).
- `removeStructuredIntegration` + verify cleanup on all exit paths (`coordinator.mjs:1160-1162`, `1176-1177`).
- `releaseResult` on success (`coordinator.mjs:1178-1180`).
- Startup `reconcile` sweeps orphan `.baton/integrate/*` (`worktree.mjs:496-510`; `sm-orphan`).

### SM10 — Honest semantic boundary

**Contract.** CPG overlap and behavioral fingerprints are advisory only; they cannot skip SM6 or advance main. True semantic merge remains research; redirect to structured merge + fresh verification.

**Implementation verdict: SATISFIED (boundary enforced).**

- `coordinator.integrate` structured path contains no Atlas CPG/fingerprint calls — only stage → verify → finalize (`coordinator.mjs:1137-1158`).
- Atlas modules are exported from `index.mjs` for separate advisory tooling (`index.mjs:41-48`) but are not wired into integration authority.
- Weak pinned commands (e.g. `true`) can admit semantically false merges; spec and evidence explicitly document this as verification-oracle limit, not structured-merge implementation scope.

## Red tests and proof

### Resolver TCB and malicious injectees

| Failure sequence | Expected refusal | Proof |
|---|---|---|
| Main diverges; `structured` with `resolver: null` | `structured_tool_unavailable`; main HEAD/status unchanged | `phase26` `SM1/SM2: missing resolver` (`test.mjs:34-41`) |
| Injected resolver returns `{status:'resolved'}` but leaves `<<<<<<<` in output (including mid-line comment) | `structured_unresolved`; stage reaped | `sm-markers`, `sm-marker-evasion`, `sm-marker-midline` (`43-55`) |
| NUL in conflict input | `structured_binary_conflict`; resolver never called (`calls === 0`) | `sm-binary-input` (`57-69`) |
| Resolver writes NUL into isolated output | `structured_binary_conflict` after one resolver call | `sm-binary-output` (`57-69`) |
| Resolver swaps `stage/src` to symlink outside repo between read and write | `structured_unsupported_path`; outside sentinel untouched; main pinned | `sm-symlink-swap` (`72-88`; `worktree.mjs:327-328`) |
| Injected `{status:'parse_fallback'}` | `structured_parse_fallback` | `sm-fallback` (`153-163`) |
| Conflict bytes > `maxFileBytes` | `structured_file_too_large`; resolver not invoked | `sm-file-bound` (`153-163`) |
| `MergirafResolver` stdout contains "falling back to line-based merge" with exit 0 | `parse_fallback` status at resolver layer | `SM1: Mergiraf resolver` (`185-193`; `structured-merge.mjs:53`) |

**Concrete marker evasion sequence (reproducible).**

1. Worker captures `export const values = { alpha: 2 };\n`; main commits `export const values = { alpha: 3 };\n`.
2. Injected resolver writes `export const ok = 1; /* <<<<<<< ours */\n` to isolated file and returns `{status:'resolved'}`.
3. `stageStructuredIntegration` UTF-8-decodes merged bytes; `CONFLICT_MARKER` matches seven `<` characters inside the comment (`worktree.mjs:263`, `325-326`).
4. Throws `structured_unresolved`; `removeStructuredIntegration` runs; main stays at pre-integrate SHA (`test.mjs:47-54`).

**Concrete symlink escape sequence (reproducible).**

1. Staging creates `.baton/integrate/<id>` with conflict at `src/value.js`; records `realConflictPath = realpathSync(absolutePath)` (`worktree.mjs:307-308`).
2. Hostile `resolve` deletes `stage/src`, symlinks `tmpdir/outside` as `stage/src`, writes innocent merge to isolated copy.
3. Pre-write `realpathSync(absolutePath)` resolves through symlink to outside path ≠ `realConflictPath` (`worktree.mjs:327-328`).
4. Refuses `structured_unsupported_path`; `readFileSync(outside/value.js)` unchanged (`test.mjs:72-87`).

### Unit-level resolver bounds (SM1)

**Sequence:** Inject `execFile` recording argv; call `resolve`. **Observed:** `args === ['solve','src/value.js']`, `opts.shell === false` (`test.mjs:185-190`). **Sequence:** stdout "falling back…", exit 0. **Observed:** `status === 'parse_fallback'` (`191-192`).

## Risks and rejection criteria

### Explicit non-goals (reject as Phase 26 defects)

1. **Live external tool.** No proof that production `mergiraf` honors argv, produces honest stdout, or solves conflicts correctly on operator machines. Evidence states binary absent; injected executor tests are the owned gate.
2. **True semantic merge.** Incompatible control/data-flow mutations with sound round-trip remain research (`spec/phase26/structured-merge.md:67-69`). Not an SM1–SM10 implementation gap.
3. **Verification oracle strength.** A pinned command as weak as `true` or non-exercising checks cannot catch semantic false-clean; SM10 redirects accountability to verification design, not resolver classification (`spec:64-69`; `sm-false-clean` only covers syntax-invalid output).

### Residual operational risks (monitor, not blocking)

| Risk | Mitigation in tree | Rejection criterion |
|---|---|---|
| Custom resolver injectee without internal timeout/output caps bypasses `MergirafResolver` bounds | Production path uses `MergirafResolver`; staging checks `maxFileBytes` only (`worktree.mjs:302`) | Re-open only if `createDriver` ships a non-bounded resolver by default |
| Invalid UTF-8 resolver output throws inside staging `try`, surfaced as `structured_merge_failed` not a dedicated code (`worktree.mjs:325`, `347`) | Still fail-closed; main unchanged | Actionable only if typed-code taxonomy is required for metrics |
| Post-effect coordination poison with main already ff-forwarded (`sm-authority-failure`) | Replay denies integration success; operator reconciliation required (`SM8`) | Reject as SM defect — this is the CK9 authority model |
| `CONFLICT_MARKER` matches marker runs anywhere in file, not line-anchored (`worktree.mjs:263`) | Strict superset of diff3 line-start markers; mid-line red passes | Reject evasion claims unless Git emits sub-seven-character markers that mergiraf leaves behind |
| Sparse verify projection misconfigured | `sparseProjection` rejects unsafe paths (`worktree.mjs:127-134`); default full checkout | Re-open if structured integration enables sparse verify without operator intent |

### Adversarial attacks considered and closed

- **PATH hijack of mergiraf binary:** spawn uses explicit `binary` path, not shell lookup (`structured-merge.mjs:41`).
- **Ambient Git config/hooks redirecting merge:** `localGitEnv` + per-invocation `-c core.hooksPath=/dev/null` on stage merge/commit and main finalize (`worktree.mjs:57-64`, `294`, `338`, `357`).
- **Resolver writing outside isolated dir:** only isolated copy is read back; stage write guarded by canonical realpath equality (`worktree.mjs:311-329`).
- **Malicious `resolved` without file write:** isolated file retains conflict markers → `structured_unresolved` (`worktree.mjs:325-326`).
- **Oversized resolver stdout/stderr:** `boundedExec` SIGKILL at `maxOutputBytes` (`structured-merge.mjs:15-16`, `21`).
- **Replay forgery of structured success:** coordination batch + operational `integration.completed` pairing required; asymmetric injection tests fail replay (`phase11` CK9; `phase26` `sm-authority-failure`).

**Closure.** Under the numbered SM1–SM10 contract at f680918, adversarial review finds no remaining implementation defect that is both actionable and unmitigated. Further work belongs to external-tool qualification, stronger verification oracles, or future semantic-merge research — not to correcting the committed structured-integration seam.
